BiblicalUsage: En-Gedi is a place in Palestine. In Joshua 15:62, the text says "and En-gedi." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Gedi matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Gedi is one of them.
